rejected.title: Batch decompilation succeeds with no bodies and no diagnostic
rejected.reject_reason: duplicate of batch-silently-omits-explicitly: one root cause (the section-flag-only image_has_executable_content test in kuna-cli/src/decompile_all.rs:1628-1653), one command, one binary, one builder. Its acceptance demanded `decompile-all <BIN> --json` exit NONZERO, which the correct fix -- count > 0 on a binary kuna demonstrably decompiles -- can never satisfy, so held open it was an unclosable need that also invited a builder to ship an error path over working analysis. The mechanism and the residual diagnostic ask are recorded in the survivor's decision log.
